title: Effects of Answer Format Variation on Gender Bias in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.17516v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Gender bias or other social biases in large language models (LLMs) are frequently evaluated with question answering or survey benchmarks where the LLM needs to give a response in a predefined answer format. It is well known in survey science that the answer format has a substantial impact on answers, just as LLMs are sensitive to the prompt wording. However, to our knowledge it has not been studied yet how changes in answer format impact the measurement of gender bias in LLMs and their alignment with human response distributions. translated_title: 答案格式变化对大语言模型中性别偏见的影响
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）中的性别偏见或其他社会偏见通常通过问答或调查基准进行评估，其中LLM需要以预定义的答案格式给出响应。在调查科学中众所周知，答案格式对回答有显著影响，正如LLM对提示措辞敏感一样。然而，据我们所知，目前尚未研究答案格式的变化如何影响LLM中性别偏见的测量及其与人类响应分布的一致性。我们在BBQ基准和OpinionQA调查数据上评估了三种指令微调模型，涵盖封闭式、李克特量表和开放式格式，在相同条件下比较偏见测量和分布一致性。我们发现答案格式确实显著改变测量结果，包括排序顺序的逆转。这些差异源于每种格式引发不同的响应模式。
tldr: 答案格式的变化会显著影响大语言模型性别偏见的测量结果，甚至导致模型排序反转，因此评估偏见时必须考虑格式效应。
en_tdlr: Answer format variation significantly alters gender bias measurements in LLMs, even reversing model rankings, highlighting the need to account for format effects in bias evaluation.
